captions.detailed: An electric tilt-only moonroof cassette consisting of a rectangular light-grey aluminum frame with rounded corners. It features a dark-tinted tempered glass panel that can tilt up at the rear, hinged along the front edge. Beneath the glass, a dark grey interior roller sunshade is mounted on a roller assembly at the front, designed to slide horizontally to cover or expose the opening.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an electric tilt-only moonroof cassette. It should feature a light-grey rounded rectangular aluminum frame, a dark-tinted glass panel that rotates via a front revolute hinge to tilt open at the rear, and a dark grey interior sunshade that slides open and closed on a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject with three main parts: a frame, a glass panel, and a sunshade. The frame is built using a rounded rectangular solid with a central cutout. The glass panel is modeled as a thin, dark-tinted translucent plate and is connected to the frame via a revolute joint (hinge) at the front edge. The sunshade is modeled as a sliding flat panel, connected to the frame with a prismatic joint along the longitudinal axis to simulate the roller shade extension.
